channel.title: The AI Treasurer: Insights
channel.description: Practical views for CFOs and Treasurers, by Gopakumar Menon.

item.title: A Bond Trade Can Now Settle While Your Treasury Team Is Asleep
item.description: What Hong Kong’s new bond platform changes for Treasury, and five questions to answer before your Treasury holds a tokenised bond.

item.title: An AI Agent Just Negotiated a Treasury Trade With Another AI Agent
item.description: What happened when two AI agents negotiated a U.S. Treasury bill trade, and five questions to answer before an agent negotiates for your Treasury.

item.title: Now your Reconciliation only takes a few minutes. So why is your team still busy?
item.description: How to plan the time automation frees up, and how to check where it went.

item.title: Your AI cash forecast just refreshed. Can Treasury prove what it knew last Monday?
item.description: Why every major Treasury decision needs a forecast version of record, and what that record should hold.

item.title: Your First AI Task in Treasury Should Be Unglamorous
item.description: Four questions to decide which tasks you can trust AI with, and which must stay with your team.
